sourceTitle: Clam Soup On A Quiet Thanksgiving
sourceText:
Clam Soup On A Quiet Thanksgiving
By: Quay Po Cooks
Published: Monday, November 29, 2010 - 5:16am

Ingredients




1 kilogram medium hard shell clams
1 tablespoon olive oil
3 garlic cloves, sliced
3/4 cup sake
1/2 teaspoon salt
4 cups chicken stock
4 tablespoons Italian parsley, chopped
1/2 teaspoon chopped rosemary
1/2 teaspoon chopped thyme
20 gms young ginger julienned

Preparation

1 Scrub the clams and rinse carefully under running water. In a large soup pot, heat the olive oil over a medium heat. Add the garlic and 10 gms ginger. Sauté till fragrant. Add chicken stock and wine and lower the heat to low. Cook for 10 minutes. Add the clams and the salt, cover, and cook for 5 - 10 minutes over a medium-high heat. (The shells should be open after this cooking period. Do not eat any clams that have not opened.) Add parsley and balance of 10gm ginger, stir, and serve.

About


My hubby had gone on a business trip and returned late last evening so while everyone was having a big feast for Thanksgiving, we had ham sandwich with clam soup and white wine.  Although we did not celebrate Thanksgiving in a big way like all the past years, we do not feel deprived at all.  In fact, it is kind of nice to spend a quiet Thanksgiving evening with simple food and watch a movie and be very thankful that we have each other.
